result.note: Brief item; tested the capacity, mandatory storage and stated purpose of the Cabinet-approved floating solar scheme.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, the Union Cabinet cleared a floating solar scheme. Consider the following statements about it:
items: The scheme covers 5,000 MW of floating solar capacity and makes storage mandatory.
The scheme is aimed at holding the midday solar surplus that transmission bottlenecks currently waste.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The Cabinet cleared a 5,000 MW floating solar scheme with mandatory storage on 3 August 2026, so both statements are correct. The scheme is aimed less at building capacity and more at storing midday power that would otherwise be lost to transmission constraints.
questions.source: The Cabinet cleared a 5,000 MW floating solar scheme with mandatory storage, aimed less at capacity building and more at holding the midday surplus that transmission bottlenecks currently waste.
